## Why this issue exists

The backend audit (`backend-paywall-audit.md` against commit `a9c1956f`)
identified three P0 paid-surface gaps where `ClientEntitlementGuard`
was missing — those are fixed in #259.

It also identified ~13 other student-reachable controllers that today
have only `JwtAuthGuard`. Whether each one is a paid feature is a
**product question**, not a security gap, so #259 deliberately does NOT
touch them. This issue tracks the product decision per surface so we
can update `docs/tier-classification.md`, the
`PAID_ROUTES` list in `test/entitlement-guards-mounted.spec.ts`, and
the controllers themselves in a follow-up PR.

## Decision needed per surface

For each row below, decide **paid** (add `ClientEntitlementGuard`) or
**free** (document the decision in `docs/tier-classification.md`). The
"Recommendation" column is the audit's suggested default; product owns
the final call.

| Surface | Controller | Current behavior | Audit risk | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/bloodwork/*` | `ClientBloodworkController` (`src/bloodwork/client-bloodwork.controller.ts`) | JwtAuthGuard only; service enforces consent | MEDIUM | Paid — premium health data |
| `/weight/*` | `WeightController` | JwtAuthGuard only | MEDIUM | Free — basic logging is retention |
| `/nutrition/water/*` | `WaterController` | JwtAuthGuard only | MEDIUM | Free — basic logging is retention |
| `/habits/*` | `HabitsController` | JwtAuthGuard only | MEDIUM | Paid — coach-driven habit programs |
| `/lessons/*` | `LessonsController` | JwtAuthGuard only | MEDIUM | Paid — coach-authored content |
| `/me/timeline` | `TimelineController` | JwtAuthGuard only | MEDIUM | Paid — full activity history |
| `/me/leaderboard` | `LeaderboardController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — engagement loop |
| `/recipes/*` | `RecipesController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — public catalog |
| `/lists/*` | `ListsController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — derived from meal plans |
| `/prep-guide` | `PrepGuideController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — onboarding asset |
| `/nudges/*` | `ClientNudgesController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — coach-driven, push-style |
| `/build-week/*` | `BuildWeekController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — day-1 retention flow |
| `/me/first-win` | `FirstWinController` | JwtAuthGuard only | LOW | Free — day-1 retention flow |

## When the decision lands

In one PR per group (or one PR for all of them):

1. Update `docs/tier-classification.md` with a "Client surface" section
   listing each route and its decision.
2. For every "paid" decision, add
   `@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, ClientEntitlementGuard)` at the controller
   class level (the guard short-circuits for coaches/owners, so coach-
   facing sibling routes are unaffected).
3. Add each newly-paid controller to `PAID_ROUTES` in
   `test/entitlement-guards-mounted.spec.ts` — the contract test will
   then fail CI if the guard is ever removed.
4. For "free" decisions, add a class-level comment naming the rationale
   (e.g., "intentionally free — retention path") so future audits can
   tell the difference between "free by decision" and "missing guard".

## References

- Audit: `backend-paywall-audit.md` (commit `a9c1956f`)
- P0 fix: #259
- Guard: `src/common/guards/client-entitlement.guard.ts`
- Contract test: `test/entitlement-guards-mounted.spec.ts`
- Engineering Rule §4: "`ClientEntitlementGuard` is applied to every paid endpoint."
